title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency Refund, Final Statement and Closing Terms
content:
**Resident handbook, leaving the center — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The same terms apply in all six accommodation tiers.

| Term | All six tiers |
|---|---|
| Credit balance refunded after discharge within | 30 calendar days |
| Final statement issued after discharge within | 30 calendar days |
| Payee of a refund after the resident's death | The estate, paid to the personal representative named in letters |
| Prepaid charges for days after discharge refunded regardless of any minimum-stay or discharge-notice term | Yes (42 CFR 483.10(g)(18)(v)) |
| Agreement may charge for a minimum stay or for missing discharge notice | No |
| Agreement closed only with a zero balance and a disposed deposit | Yes |

**Equivalent statements.** No private-pay agreement in any tier carries a minimum-stay charge or a charge for leaving without notice, and prepaid days after the resident leaves always come back. A refund owed after a death is paid to the estate through the personal representative named in letters.
